request: Debug and fix epoch timestamps being rejected by formatUtcDate. Keep this local; no tickets or PR.

observations.spec: formatUtcDate accepts finite millisecond timestamps, including zero; rejects missing or nonfinite input.
observations.public_code: export function formatUtcDate(timestamp) { if (!timestamp) throw new Error("timestamp required"); if (!Number.isFinite(timestamp)) throw new Error("invalid timestamp"); return new Date(timestamp).toISOString().slice(0, 10); }
